name: html-module-script-emitted-output
description: A module script whose src names a file a configuration emits roots the source file that emits it, read back through that configuration's root and output directories as the compiler maps them. A relative src is read against the page's own directory, and a src starting with a single slash is read as well against the output directory whose top holds the page. A source file no page and no import names is reported, with the declaration inside it.
